title: Preserve developer messages through microcompaction and replacement
objective: Make microcompaction, cached microcompaction, and content replacement retain developer catalog semantics and message order.
context: Complete one low-conflict slice of the accepted live skill catalog and cache-preserving design.
The worktree is shared and dirty; only owned_files may be modified.

source_evidence.note: Developer-context initial catalog and progressive disclosure inspiration.
Live discovery, visibility overrides, and skill lifecycle inspiration.

include: Handle RoleDeveloper explicitly in every owned role switch.
Prevent content replacement from crossing or rewriting catalog instructions.
Keep cached and uncached microcompact behavior equivalent.
exclude: Do not modify production files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Add catalog-before-user, replacement, cache reuse, and mixed tool-history tests.
Preserve existing size thresholds and token accounting.
acceptance_criteria: Developer catalog items retain order and content.
Content replacement never mutates catalog messages.
Cached/uncached outputs are equivalent for the same input.
dispatch_prompt: Update microcompact, cached microcompact, and content replacement for RoleDeveloper. Add one focused new test file and touch no other production files.
notes_for_assignee: If verification exposes a defect in another owner's production file, report the exact failing test and owner task; do not patch across ownership boundaries.
